package redispubsubdemo

import (
	"context"

	"github.com/redis/go-redis/v9"
	"github.com/gomodule/redigo/redis"
)

func PublishUpdate(ctx context.Context, rdb *go_redis.Client) error {
	return rdb.Publish(ctx, "notifications", "hello").Err()
}

func SubscribeNotifs(ctx context.Context, rdb *go_redis.Client) *go_redis.PubSub {
	return rdb.Subscribe(ctx, "notifications", "alerts")
}

func PatternSubscribe(ctx context.Context, rdb *go_redis.Client) *go_redis.PubSub {
	return rdb.PSubscribe(ctx, "events.*")
}

func PublishViaRedigo(conn redis.Conn) (interface{}, error) {
	return conn.Do("PUBLISH", "deprecated.ch", "payload")
}
